issues.legal_issue: A consent decree whose terms themselves transfer title to immovable property between living parties falls within the definitions of conveyance and instrument and is subject to stamp duty.
material_facts: The decrees were made before the 1985 amendment to the statutory definition of conveyance.
The consent terms provided that the defendants granted, sold, conveyed and transferred the immovable property to the plaintiffs, and that the decree itself would operate as the conveyance.
The terms recorded that the full purchase price had been paid and that vacant possession had been delivered.
The dispute concerned whether the decrees were liable to stamp duty.
issues.conclusion: The consent decrees qualified as both conveyances and instruments under the definitions then in force and were liable to stamp duty under Entry 25 of Schedule I.
issues.legal_principle: Under Sections 2(g) and 2(1) of the Bombay Stamps Act, 1958, the inclusive definitions of conveyance and instrument are broad enough to cover a consent decree when its terms effect a transfer of property between living parties. The substance and terms of the document, rather than its label or the court stamp, determine its character; a compromise decree does not stand above the agreement on which it is based. The 1985 amendment was made out of abundant caution and did not mean that such a decree was previously excluded. Sharanbasappa Tippanna Indi v. Sanganbasappa Sridramappa Shahapur was distinguished because it concerned a decree creating a charge on property that was not the subject matter of the suit, not a decree operating as a conveyance.

rule.if: stamp_duty_classification_proceeding and consent_decree and decree_itself_effects_property_transfer and transfer_between_living_parties

predicates.stamp_duty_classification_proceeding: The proceeding determines whether a document is liable to stamp duty.
predicates.consent_decree: A court enters a decree based on the parties' agreement.
predicates.decree_itself_effects_property_transfer: The decree's terms themselves provide for title to property to pass from one party to another.
predicates.transfer_between_living_parties: The agreed transfer is made between living parties.

issues.definition: When a stamp-duty classification proceeding concerns a consent decree that itself transfers property between living parties, the decree is chargeable as a conveyance.
